import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_72/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_72/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "city"
# Both tables have a "city" column, join on this key
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by on Source4_72_0.city (which is "city" column)
# Aggregations: avg(Source4_72_0.fare) -> average fare from df0
#               sum(Source4_72_1.driver_count) -> sum of driver_count from df1

# Group by city and aggregate accordingly
grouped = df_joined.groupby("city").agg(
    a=pd.NamedAgg(column="fare", aggfunc="mean"),
    b=pd.NamedAgg(column="driver_count", aggfunc="sum")
).reset_index()

# Ensure target schema and types:
# Target schema: ['city': string, 'a': float, 'b': integer]
grouped["city"] = grouped["city"].astype(str)
grouped["a"] = grouped["a"].astype(float)
grouped["b"] = grouped["b"].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_72/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_72/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_72/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by city (the primary key), aggregate avg of fare and sum of driver_count
result = joined.groupby("city", as_index=False).agg({
    "fare": "mean",
    "driver_count": "sum"
})

# Rename columns to match target schema
result = result.rename(columns={"fare": "a", "driver_count": "b"})

# Write output to the specified path
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_72/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
